subject.title: Feature request: Escalating stall recovery for sub-agents (nudge → kill)

question: Should OpenClaw add sub-agent-specific two-stage stall recovery with new default-on nudge/kill thresholds, or should generic diagnostic abort recovery remain the only built-in backstop for now?
rationale: The remaining work changes recovery semantics, visible chat behavior, and default/config surface for existing deployments, which requires maintainer product intent rather than an autonomous bug-fix patch.

options.title: Design default-on two-stage recovery
options.body: Add a gateway/agent-owned nudge-then-kill policy with upgrade-safe defaults, parent/channel notification behavior, and tests for chat queue recovery.

options.title: Keep generic diagnostic abort only
options.body: Treat current `diagnostics.stuckSessionAbortMs` recovery as sufficient and leave graceful warnings/manual controls to narrower issues.

options.title: Make this opt-in watchdog work
options.body: Route remaining behavior through the broader session activity/watchdog design before adding sub-agent-specific config.

recommendation.title: Design default-on two-stage recovery
recommendation.body: Add a gateway/agent-owned nudge-then-kill policy with upgrade-safe defaults, parent/channel notification behavior, and tests for chat queue recovery.
